kilns.name: Ru Kiln
kilns.ability: Once per round, when you complete an Order using a Masterpiece with Celadon Glaze and Plain Decoration, gain 4 VP. The Order itself does not need to require Masterpiece, Celadon or Plain; the delivered ceramic must actually have those attributes.
kilns.abilityZh: 每轮一次，当你完成委托时，若所交付的器物中有1件是臻品、青釉、素面，获得4分。委托本身不必要求臻品、青釉或素面；只看实际交付器物的属性。
kilns.shortText: Once per round, when you complete an Order using a Plain Celadon Masterpiece: gain 4 VP.
kilns.shortTextZh: 每轮一次，以素面青釉臻品完成委托时：得4分。

clarifications.en: Ru triggers while completing an Order in the Order Phase.
clarifications.zh: 汝窑在交货阶段完成委托时触发。

kilns.name: Guan Kiln
kilns.ability: Once per round, when you complete an Order showing at least 1 Crown, gain 2 Coins and 1 VP.
kilns.abilityZh: 每轮一次，当你完成一张印有至少1个御令的委托时，获得2铜钱和1分。
kilns.shortText: Once per round, when you complete a Crown Order: gain 2 Coins + 1 VP.
kilns.shortTextZh: 每轮一次，完成御令委托时：得2铜钱和1分。

clarifications.en: Guan triggers while completing an Order in the Order Phase.
clarifications.zh: 官窑在交货阶段完成委托时触发。

clarifications.en: Tribute Ware's bonus Crown is not a printed Crown and does not make an Order "showing a Crown".
clarifications.zh: 贡瓷额外获得的御令不是委托上印有的御令，不会让委托算作“印有御令”。

kilns.name: Ge Kiln
kilns.ability: Once per round, after Quality is assigned, choose 1 of your Fine or Standard ceramics from this firing: it develops Crackle and is Fine (a Standard one becomes Fine). Place a Crackle marker on it; the ceramic keeps the marker. When completing an Order, each of your Crackle ceramics may count as having any one Decoration for that Order's Decoration requirements; its printed Decoration is unchanged. Each Crackle ceramic you deliver to complete an Order scores 1 VP.
kilns.abilityZh: 每轮一次，定品后，选择你本次烧成中的1件上品或良品：它开片，品质为上品（良品升为上品）。在它上面放1个开片标，此标一直留在该器物上。完成委托时，你的每件开片器都可以视为具有任意一种纹饰，以满足该委托的纹饰要求；它原本的纹饰不变。你每交付1件开片器完成委托，得1分。
kilns.shortText: Once per round, after Quality is assigned: 1 of your Fine or Standard ceramics from this firing → Crackle; it is Fine. Orders: each Crackle ceramic may count as any 1 Decoration and scores 1 VP when delivered.
kilns.shortTextZh: 每轮一次，定品后：可令己方本窑1件上品或良品开片→品质为上品。完成委托时：每件开片器可作任意1种纹饰，交付时得1分。

clarifications.en: Ge targets 1 of your ceramics from this firing that is Fine or Standard at that moment; a Masterpiece or Flawed ceramic is not a target. A Standard one becomes Fine, a Fine one stays Fine, and it permanently carries a Crackle marker.
clarifications.zh: 哥窑选择你本次烧成中1件此时为上品或良品的器物；臻品与瑕品不能选。良品升为上品，上品仍是上品，并一直带着开片标。

clarifications.en: Ge's Crackle is an after-Quality effect; Ge chooses its order among their own after-Quality effects. With Protective Saggars, a ceramic that would have been Flawed is Standard and may be crackled; Saggars' Standard → Fine step and Crackle may both apply to the same ceramic.
clarifications.zh: 哥窑开片是定品后效果；哥窑玩家自行决定它在己方各项定品后效果中的先后。有匣钵护烧时，本应为瑕品的器物算作良品，可以再开片；匣钵护烧的“良品变上品”与开片可以作用于同一件器物。

clarifications.en: An Imperial Kiln ceramic counts as a ceramic in this firing for your abilities.
clarifications.zh: 对你的能力而言，御窑中的器物算作本次烧成中的器物。

clarifications.en: A marked ceramic keeps its Crackle marker until delivered or exhibited.
clarifications.zh: 带有开片标的器物一直保留此标，直到交付或陈列。

clarifications.en: Crackle VP triggers while completing an Order in the Order Phase, where a Crackle ceramic's wildcard Decoration is declared. It is automatic and recorded with the Order as Kiln Tradition VP.
clarifications.zh: 开片器的得分在交货阶段完成委托时触发，开片器的任意纹饰也在此时声明。它自动计入，作为窑口传承所得的分数随委托记录。

kilns.name: Ding Kiln
kilns.ability: Once per round, when resolving a Form & Decorate action, after you form a Bowl, Plate or Brush Washer, you may pay 1 Clay and 1 Coin to form one additional vessel of the same Shape, with any Decoration. It does not count against the action's vessel limit and is not one of the 2 vessels for the Shifu's discount. For effects that refer to vessels formed by that action, it counts as formed by that action.
kilns.abilityZh: 每轮一次，结算制坯饰纹行动时，在你制成1件碗、盘或笔洗之后，可以支付1泥和1铜钱，再制1件同器型的坯，纹饰任选。它不计入该行动的制坯件数上限，也不算师傅减免所说的“2件”之一；对于提到“该行动所制坯”的效果，它算作该行动所制。
kilns.shortText: Once per round, during a Form & Decorate action: after forming a Bowl, Plate or Brush Washer, pay 1 Clay + 1 Coin → form 1 extra vessel of the same Shape with any Decoration (no discounts). It counts as formed by that action.
kilns.shortTextZh: 每轮一次，制坯饰纹行动中制成碗、盘或笔洗后：可付1泥1铜钱→多制1件同器型的坯，纹饰任选，不享减免。算作该行动所制。

clarifications.en: Ding's ability works with either worker type.
clarifications.zh: 学徒或师傅的行动都能触发定窑的能力。

clarifications.en: Ding triggers during its Form & Decorate action.
clarifications.zh: 定窑在其制坯饰纹行动中触发。

clarifications.en: Prepared Clay is a Tech effect and never counts as a Form & Decorate action, so a vessel formed through Prepared Clay does not trigger Ding.
clarifications.zh: 练泥是技艺效果，不算制坯饰纹行动，所以通过练泥制成的坯不会触发定窑。

clarifications.en: The Shifu's discount, Decorator's Kit and Ding's 1-Coin vessel are three separate reductions. Ding's vessel takes neither. Large Throwing Wheel reduces Clay only; Ding's vessel is not a Vase or Censer.
clarifications.zh: 师傅的减免、饰坯匣、定窑的1铜钱额外坯是三项各自独立的减免；定窑的额外坯两项都不适用。大陶车只减泥；定窑的额外坯不是瓶或香炉。

kilns.name: Jun Kiln
kilns.ability: Once per round, after Actual Heat is calculated but before Quality is assigned, you may pay 1 Wood to adjust the Actual Heat of one of your ceramics by +1 or −1.
kilns.abilityZh: 每轮一次，实际火候算出后、定品前，你可以支付1柴，把你1件器物的实际火候调整+1或−1。
kilns.shortText: Once per round, after Actual Heat is calculated, before Quality: pay 1 Wood → adjust 1 of your ceramics' Actual Heat by +1 or −1.
kilns.shortTextZh: 每轮一次，实际火候算出后、定品前：可付1柴→己方1件器物的实际火候+1或−1。

clarifications.en: Jun acts after Actual Heat is calculated (Kiln Master marker included) and before Quality is assigned.
clarifications.zh: 钧窑在实际火候算出后（已计入窑工标）、定品前结算。

clarifications.en: Jun's adjustment applies on top of Kiln Master's marker.
clarifications.zh: 钧窑的调整叠加在窑工标之上。

clarifications.en: An Imperial Kiln ceramic counts as a ceramic in this firing for your abilities.
clarifications.zh: 对你的能力而言，御窑中的器物算作本次烧成中的器物。

clarifications.en: Global Heat and Actual Heat are not clamped.
clarifications.zh: 全窑火候与实际火候不设上下限。

clarifications.en: If a Second Firing recalculates a ceramic, an unused Jun adjustment may be applied to the recalculated heat. Jun's adjustment from the first calculation does not carry over.
clarifications.zh: 若复烧重算了某件器物，尚未使用的钧窑调整可以作用于重算后的火候；第一次计算时的钧窑调整不保留。
